failure_diagnostics.interpretation: The worker identity fix passed. Account socket preflight then rejected a supported deployment because the runuser supplementary group syntax was incorrect. The installer did not change socket permissions or start a service.

additional_limitations: Emulated amd64 CPU; this establishes independent-kernel functionality, not native amd64 performance.

Guest reboot cleared /tmp. The frozen acceptance harness and integration helper were recopied before resume; the installed service, data, configuration, and persistent acceptance state were untouched.
This report covers candidate v3. Later bootstrap-only fixes were tested separately and are not implied to have rerun this guest matrix.
